## Goal
- Build a real autonomous IVX Senior Developer Worker (IVX-SENIOR-DEV-01) that operates without Rork browser, can read/edit code, run tests, commit to GitHub, deploy to Render, verify production, and return proof to IVX chat — replacing the fake "senior developer" certification with an honest, working system.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- System must work when Rork browser is closed — no Rork session dependency for runtime execution
- Every engineering request must return HTTP 202 with: taskId, status, taskType, assignedWorker, approvalRequired, createdAt
- Owner approval phrases required for: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_DATABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL, CONFIRM_IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLE
- Do not label system "IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER — VERIFIED" until chat-only certification test passes (Rork closed, IVX-only task completes end-to-end)
- Use "IVX OWNER AI — ENGINEERING COMMAND INTERFACE" as the honest label until then
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Plan Mode could not be activated (switchMode timed out twice, then blocked by policy) — proceeding in Agent Mode with explicit owner approval
- Plan files cannot be created in `.rork/plans/` outside Plan Mode — created as `docs/` file instead
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`

## Progress
### Done
- HONEST AUDIT OF IVX CHAT MODULE — confirmed to owner that IVX IA is NOT a senior developer:
  - IVX chat is a "secretary AI" — only routes messages, cannot write/edit/commit/deploy code
  - 12 engineering teams are database rows, not executable workers; only TEAM-12 can deploy (label only)
  - `ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` is a workflow/API caller, not an AI that reasons about code
  - Chat transport is broken: 503 errors, "Message is required" (wrong field name `prompt` vs `message`), provider stuck in `PROVIDER_VALIDATING`
  - `expo/app/admin/ivx-developer-workspace.tsx` (Code Developer Workspace, BLOCK 18) is a UI screen with static file registry + AsyncStorage patches — not autonomous, not independent from Rork
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-tools.ts` has 10 read-only tools — none can write code autonomously
  - Acknowledged to owner that prior "Senior Developer VERIFIED" certifications were misleading — they certified the pipeline, not the chat
- 21-MILESTONE END-TO-END AUDIT COMPLETED (fixed script `/tmp/audit_21_v2.py`):
  - 3-way SHA parity TRUE at time of audit: GitHub = Runtime = `8f1939f650cb`
  - All 21 milestones passed (Kotlin retired, 12/12 teams active, APK v1.4.8 84MB, 7 health endpoints 200, 10 verified tasks, 15 durable tasks, feed live with 7 videos)
- TESTS + TYPECHECK PASSED (post-deploy):
  - Backend `tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors
  - Expo `tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors
  - Media tests: 37 pass, 0 fail, 100 expect() calls across 3 files
- CERTIFICATION DOC PUSHED to GitHub (commit `b8cb9985af46`) — Render auto-deployed, parity confirmed
- PRODUCTION ADVANCED from `8f1939f650cb` → `b8cb9985af46` (docs sync, boot 2026-07-18T21:27:05Z)
- IMPLEMENTATION PLAN CREATED at `docs/ivx-autonomous-senior-developer-plan.md` (could not create in `.rork/plans/` due to Plan Mode block)
- NEW FILES CREATED for autonomous senior developer worker:
  - `deploy/supabase/ivx-senior-dev-worker-migrations.sql` — 4 new tables: `ivx_senior_dev_worker_runs`, `ivx_senior_dev_checkpoints`, `ivx_senior_dev_approvals`; extends `ivx_owner_ai_tasks` with `task_type`, `assigned_worker_id`, `approval_url`, `worker_data`, `files_changed`, `test_summary`, `commit_sha`, `render_deploy_id`, `runtime_sha`, `proof_ledger_id`; RLS policies
  - `backend/api/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` — Worker API: POST `/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` (submit, returns 202), GET `/:taskId` (poll status), POST `/:taskId/approve` (owner approval)
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-proof.ts` — Proof ledger + approval records via Supabase REST API; `writeProofLedger`, `updateProofLedger`, `recordApproval`, `hasApproval`
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` — Main worker loop: polls `ivx_owner_ai_tasks` for `senior_dev` tasks, claims via heartbeat, executes 8-phase pipeline (PLANNING→INSPECTING→IMPLEMENTING→TESTING→WAITING_APPROVAL→COMMITTING→DEPLOYING→LIVE_VERIFYING→VERIFIED), writes proof ledger
  - `backend/workers/ivx-senior-dev-worker-entry.ts` — Process entry point for standalone Render worker service
- FILES MODIFIED:
  - `backend/hono.ts` — Added import + 3 new routes: `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs`, `GET /:taskId`, `POST /:taskId/approve` (lines ~3116-3118)
  - `render.yaml` — Added `ivx-senior-dev-01` worker service (type: worker, Docker, standard plan, env vars synced)
  - `backend/worker.ts` — Added `startSeniorDevWorker()` call when `IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLED=true`

### In Progress
- TYPECHECK FIXES NEEDED — `bun x tsc --noEmit` revealed errors in new worker files:
  - `backend/api/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`: import path `../owner-only` should be `../api/owner-only`; `patchTask` not exported from `ivx-owner-ai-task-queue.ts`; new fields (`task_type`, `assigned_worker_id`, `files_changed`, `commit_sha`, `render_deploy_id`, `runtime_sha`, `proof_ledger_id`) not in `IVXOwnerAITaskRow` interface; `COMMITTING` not in `IVXOwnerAITaskStatus` type
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`: same `patchTask` export issue + `IVXOwnerAITaskRow` field issues + `listTasks` may not exist as exported function
  - Need to: (1) export `patchTask` from `ivx-owner-ai-task-queue.ts`, (2) extend `IVXOwnerAITaskRow` with new fields, (3) add new states to `IVXOwnerAITaskStatus`, (4) fix import path, (5) verify `listTasks` exists and is exported

### Blocked
- Plan Mode cannot be activated (switchMode timed out + blocked by policy) — proceeding in Agent Mode
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — `worker:senior-dev` script not added (workaround: worker starts via `backend/worker.ts` integration)
- SMS reporting: No approved SMS provider configured
- iOS TestFlight + Google Play AAB signing: owner credentials not provided
- Physical device QA: owner-device testing required (7 tests)
- Factory agent activation (FA-01..50): owner pilot selection required
- FINAL MANDATE Phases 3-7: factory isolation infrastructure, FA-01..50 build, pilot selection

## Key Decisions
- Owner explicitly acknowledged IVX IA is NOT a senior developer and approved building the real autonomous worker
- Plan created as `docs/ivx-autonomous-senior-developer-plan.md` instead of `.rork/plans/` because Plan Mode was blocked
- Worker integrated into existing `backend/worker.ts` process (not separate npm script) because `package.json` cannot be edited directly
- Worker uses Supabase REST API (not SDK) for proof ledger to minimize dependencies
- Worker API accepts both `goal` and `prompt` fields to fix the chat transport bug
- State machine extended beyond original: added PLANNING, INSPECTING, IMPLEMENTING, TESTING, COMMITTING, DEPLOYING, LIVE_VERIFYING, ROLLING_BACK to non-terminal states
- All prior "Senior Developer VERIFIED" labels acknowledged as misleading — system is now honestly labeled "IVX OWNER AI — ENGINEERING COMMAND INTERFACE"

## Next Steps
1. Fix TypeScript errors in new worker files:
   - Export `patchTask` and `listTasks` from `backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-task-queue.ts`
   - Extend `IVXOwnerAITaskRow` with: `task_type`, `assigned_worker_id`, `approval_url`, `worker_data`, `files_changed`, `test_summary`, `commit_sha`, `render_deploy_id`, `runtime_sha`, `proof_ledger_id`
   - Add `PLANNING`, `INSPECTING`, `IMPLEMENTING`, `TESTING`, `COMMITTING`, `DEPLOYING`, `LIVE_VERIFYING`, `ROLLING_BACK` to `IVXOwnerAITaskStatus`
   - Fix import path in `backend/api/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`: `../owner-only` → `../api/owner-only`
2. Run `bun x tsc --noEmit` to verify 0 errors
3. Run database migrations against Supabase
4. Fix chat transport in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` — route engineering requests to new `/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` endpoint
5. Add task status polling + approval UI to IVX chat screen
6. Deploy to production and run first chat-only certification test
